_comment: TD-126 (2026-08-30) pinned panel for the whatsapp_registration_accessible fix. Same oracle-validity basis as TD-105's own whatsapp fixtures (tests/fixtures/ooni_whatsapp_web_accessible_classification/pinned_measurements.json, tests/fixtures/ooni_whatsapp_endpoints_blocked_count_removed/pinned_measurements.json): whatsapp has a valid, non-degenerate oracle (OONI's own /api/v1/measurements), so OONI's live classification is used as ground truth for every row here. Every entry below was independently re-fetched live from OONI's API during the TD-126 build session (2026-08-30), not copied from the characterization session's earlier fetch.

entries.note: Reclassified: registration_server_status='blocked' (probe's own field) but registration_server_failure='http_request_failed' -- the actual $.requests[] entry for https://v.whatsapp.net/v2/register has failure=null and a real HTTP 503 response. Transport succeeded; only the probe's own higher-level status categorization disagreed. OONI's own live API confirms OK (anomaly=false) -- this is the exact measurement the TD-100/ADR-0013 agreement-check harness's rotating sample surfaced as a new disagreement on 2026-08-30, which triggered this fix's characterization.

Second reclassified example, same shape as the first (registration_server_failure='http_request_failed', identical 403/400/503 raw HTTP status signature across all three requests, same probe_asn, 8 months apart) -- confirms the fix isn't specific to one moment in time. This is the entire live population of this shape as of 2026-08-30 (confirmed by parsing raw_test_keys.requests[] across all 278 registration_server_status='blocked' sole-driver rows, not sampling): exactly these 2 measurement_ids have a genuinely non-null v2/register request failure. OONI's own live API confirms OK (anomaly=false).

Regression guard: registration_server_failure='connection_reset' -- the v2/register request's own failure field is genuinely non-null (a real transport-level failure, not an unexpected-but-received HTTP response). whatsapp_registration_accessible correctly stays FALSE, verdict stays ANOMALOUS. OONI's own live API confirms ANOMALOUS (anomaly=true). Proves the fix does not suppress the 276/278 rows with a real, matching transport failure.

Regression guard: whatsapp_web_accessible IS FALSE (bug (a)'s condition, a real HTTPS-leg failure), registration_server_status='ok' -- a different, untouched driver. Must stay ANOMALOUS via the web-check condition regardless of this fix. OONI's own live API confirms ANOMALOUS (anomaly=true). Proves this fix doesn't accidentally affect rows driven by a different OR-chain condition.

Regression guard: already-OK row, no OR-chain condition true before or after (whatsapp_endpoints_status='ok', whatsapp_web_accessible=TRUE, registration_server_status='ok'). OONI's own live API confirms OK. Proves the fix does not touch rows never affected by registration_server_status in the first place.
